THE COMPLETE STORY

The outcome belongs at the beginning.

Section link

Pinnacle begins with the life a child is working toward: communicating, learning, making choices, taking part, growing in confidence and becoming increasingly independent. That purpose guides what is measured, which goals matter, who participates, how therapy reaches everyday life and when the plan is reviewed.

Purpose

A self-sufficient, mainstream and wonderful life for the child determines the abilities, goals, people, methods, everyday practice and review.

Measure and plan

The seven-stage pathway connects capability identification and AbilityScore® measurement with readiness forecasting and a child-specific plan.

Support everyday participation

Integrated intervention, parent-guided practice, progress review and reassessment work toward growing independence and participation.

SEVEN-STAGE DEVELOPMENTAL PATHWAY

From capability to participation.

Section link
  1. Identify capabilities and measure ability
  2. Forecast readiness and create a child-specific plan
  3. Provide integrated therapies and intervention
  4. Support parent-guided everyday practice and home generalisation
  5. Track progress and correct the plan
  6. Reassess and repeat until readiness
  7. Support growing independence, school readiness and mainstream participation

23 SEPTEMBER 2026

Export ready from India.

Section link

Free Sale Certificate FSC/MD/2026/000741 records that the licensed PinnacleAI GPT-OS v1.0.0 may be manufactured and sold in India and exported subject to the law of the importing country. This creates a documented starting point for country-specific registration and market-access work. Read the public certificate or read its forwarding letter.

Current public status: Indian regulatory and export-documentation foundation established. No foreign registration is claimed on this page.

INTERNATIONAL PATHWAY

Progress that can be verified market by market.

Section link

Every country will move through an evidence-backed status: researching requirements, local representative appointed, technical file prepared, submitted, under review and registered. A country moves to “submitted” only when a submission receipt is available, and to “registered” only when the competent authority issues the relevant record.

QUESTIONS FROM FAMILIES AND PARTNERS

Questions, answered with context.

Section link
What is PinnacleAI®?

PinnacleAI® GPT-OS v1.0.0 is identified in the supplied Indian manufacturing licence as Class B, non-diagnostic developmental-support software for children aged 0–12. Its stated functions include developmental ability measurement, readiness tracking, progress forecasting and adaptive therapy-plan support.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
Who is the legal manufacturer?

Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited is the licence holder and legal manufacturer named in the reviewed regulatory records. Pinnacle Blooms Network is the child-development brand and service ecosystem.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
What does the Free Sale Certificate establish?

FSC/MD/2026/000741 records Indian domestic marketability and export eligibility for the licensed device. It supports country-specific market-access applications; it is not approval or registration in another country.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
Does PinnacleAI® diagnose children?

No. The licensed product is described as non-diagnostic developmental-support software. Clinical and care decisions remain within the appropriate human and professional review process.

Share thisWhatsApp
XShare image
Has PinnacleAI® been registered in other countries?

This page does not claim a foreign registration. Each market will be labelled researching, representative appointed, technical file prepared, submitted, under review or registered only when the corresponding evidence is available.
